text:
maria: FYI inbound from EU gov prospect asking if we can guarantee 100% EU data path for inference and logs. They want to avoid any control-plane or telemetry touching US.

sam: do we have a clear breakdown of control plane vs data plane locations for hosted customers? customer wants pricing delta if we must switch to Dedicated or Private.

alex: short answer: hosted control plane currently lives in us-west by default; inference/data can be pinned to eu-west regions. full EU-only (control plane excluded) requires Private or a special EMEA control plane deployment.

lee: alex correct. For Dedicated we can guarantee all inference, cache, and logs remain in EU. Control plane signals (billing, account mgmt) still default to us unless customer requests EU control-plane early in contract. That triggers an enterprise eng workflow.

maria: customer also asked about subprocessors (auditors/cloud infra). They want a list plus whether any EU-hosted subproc still rely on US-based creds.

alex: we have an up-to-date subprocessor attestation doc: https://redwood.example.com/subprocessors/eu. Key notes: EU region infra providers (gcp-eu, aws-eu) are the primary compute subprocessors. Backup services (monitoring/alerts) may call out to hosted SaaS in US unless gated in Private.

kate: legal: we can provide DPA + subprocessor list and redact contact info, but if they require contractual guarantee of NEVER using certain subprocessors, that's a procurement negotiation. Also bakal compliance for eIDAS? ask them specifics.

maria: they also raised key management: BYOK requirement and HSM in-EU. is that feasible?

lee: BYOK + EU HSM is supported on Private. For Dedicated we can do KMS in customer VPC or bring-your-own key material via KMS connectors, but HSM-backed CRL/attestation needs ops lead and extra billing.

sam: pricing question: ballpark uplift for Dedicated vs Hosted for an EU-only contract (incl. BYOK, EU logs retention)?

alex: rough: hosted -> base; Dedicated typically 3-5x for committed capacity depending on GPUs, plus 10-15% for BYOK/HSM/attestation features. Private (control plane in EU) adds one-time setup costs ~6-8k + monthly infra delta. I'll need exact numbers from finance.

maria: customer asks routing policy: if a request originates from EU, can we guarantee it never egresses to other regions even for overload failover?

lee: we have routing policies but failover can be configured. By default we prefer same-region serving; cross-region failover is optional and can be disabled in Dedicated/Private SLAs. If they disable failover, they accept possible throttling during regional outage.

maria: they insisted on an explicit config snippet to show how we'd pin region and disable failover. can someone paste a sample config?

alex: here's a minimal example they can use in their infra request: ```
routes:
  - name: eu-only
    region_priority: [eu-west-1]
    allow_cross_region_failover: false
    subprocessors: [gcp-eu, aws-eu]
    kms: eu-kms-byo
```

sam: perfect. I'll add a note: `allow_cross_region_failover: false` means we won't route to other regions even under capacity pressure — SLA consequences apply.

kate: legal wants to insert language in the SOW/annex: "Provider will not egress inference request payloads or logs outside the EU for the contracted tenant except as required by law." will need security/ops review.

lee: ops: to satisfy that we need Dedicated with tenant isolation or Private. Hosted can't give contractually guaranteed EU-only control-plane.

maria: next steps for the deal: 1) send subprocessors attestation and DPA (kate) 2) finance to give Dedicated + Private pricing delta (alex) 3) ops run feasibility for EU control plane timeline (lee) 4) sample routing config + BYOK steps (sam).

maria: tagging @ingrid-bot to create a follow-up ticket for ops/infra with checklist.

ingrid-bot: ticket created: INF-7894 "EU-gov customer: control-plane-eu feasibility + subproc gating" assigned to lee, due 2024-11-05. :white_check_mark:

lee: got it, will pick up tomorrow and loop in infra.

maria: thanks all. i'll update the customer with interim answers and attach the snippet. :thumbsup:

sam: happy to be on the next call if they want an architecture walkthrough.

kate: I'll prepare a redacted subproc list and DPA; ping me if they want clause edits.

maria: closing thread for now, will reopen if customer pushes hard on control plane.
